title: Classic nest
idea: Richard's idea drawn straight: Shelf's bookmark in paper, the largest play hole its walls allow, and a paper pause sitting on the play's incircle. The play is the dark tile showing through and the pause is the bookmark's own paper again, so one shape carries save, listen and pause.
built: Bookmark at Shelf's proportions, 43.5 dp wide with its top at 27.1, as large as the 66 dp safe circle allows (reach 32.6 dp). The play is equilateral, 38.3 dp tall, with its corners rounded at the bookmark's shoulder radius (5.1 dp); it is the largest that keeps at least 6 dp of paper round it: 6 at the top corner and over the notch, 8.2 on the left, 7.3 past the drawn tip. Its centroid sits 2.5 dp left of the centre line, which puts the drawn play's box 0.5 dp right of it, halfway between centroid and box centring; that is what looks centred inside a rectangle. The pause sits on the incircle (radius 11.05 dp): bars 3.4 x 11.4 dp, 3.1 dp apart, corner radius 1 dp, with 4 dp of dark to the slanted sides and 6.1 dp to the flat side. The extra on the flat side is deliberate: a gap that runs parallel to a bar looks narrower than the same gap at a corner. One even-odd path.
small: 48 px: bookmark 28 x 34 px, play 24 px tall with its sides at 4:7 (within a degree of equilateral) and r 3 corners, 3.8 to 5 px of paper round it. The pause is dropped there: once a 3 px ring and a 3 px gap come out of a play with a 7 px incircle, 3 px bars could only be about 4 px tall. 32 px: bookmark 20 x 24 px with a 16 px play and 3 to 4 px walls, no pause. 16 px: bookmark 10 x 12 px with a 4 x 7 px play drawn in whole pixels, so it stays crisp. Glyph 24: bookmark 16 x 20 px with a 12 px play hole and at least 3 px of white round it; no pause, since the media notification beside it already carries play and pause. The pause therefore lives only in the launcher icon and on the launch screens.
risks: Google Play Books also builds its icon from a bookmark-like shape round a play triangle; the pause island, the single colour and Shelf's square shoulders set this apart, and only the last two survive below 64 px. On a home screen at 1x the pause shrinks to two specks and the icon reads as a bookmark with a play button, which could suggest a podcast or video app. The toolbar cuts carry the play alone.
